Sahas sabhi gunon mein sabse zaroori hai, kyunki sahas ke bina koi bhi gun lagatar nahi chal sakta.
Bhay admission ka fee hai.
Khamoshi ek bahut badi taakat ka zariya hai.
Khamoshi choose bhi ki ja sakti.
Darr ke bhi kaam karna bahaduri hai.
Jeetne ke liye aapko ek hi ladai baar-baar ladni pad sakti hai.
Khamoshi chup hai.
Takat chuppi mein badhti hai.
Bohot defeats mil sakte, par defeated nahi hona.
Grit failure ko fuel bana deta hai.
Har us anubhav se jo tum dar ka saamna karte ho, tumhe taakat, sahas aur atma-vishwas milta hai.
Courage—vulnerable hone ki willingness se shuru.
Taqat aur khamoshi dost hain.
Courage i resistance to fear, mastery of fear—na absence of fear.
Mehnat hunar ko maat deti hai.
Khamoshi golden; par action bhi gold hai.
Doubt ke bawajood kaam karna—himmat.
Sabse zyada khamosh logon ke dimaag mein sabse zyada shor hota hai.
